title: 真实重试跨优先级：换host仍可同域失败，按批准拓扑重试到下一域且不放大写请求
body:
## 操作任务
实现configure(base)，深拷贝后只给name=read的retry_policy添加envoy.retry_priorities.previous_priorities，typed_config类型PreviousPrioritiesConfig，update_frequency=1。已批准的priority0映射zone-A两主机、priority1映射zone-B一主机。原previous_hosts避免同主机，但同域两个503仍会耗尽两次尝试；须让GET第二次实际到priority1并成功。保留num_retries=1、超时、host选择次数、端点/优先级、POST不重试及健康例外。两域都503时也只能总共2次；主域恢复后一次成功不强行跨域。不能以提高次数、标记故障主机永久不健康或把所有请求都改到备用域绕过。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Envoy1.36.13和三个独立回环HTTP后端，源端实收证明主机及优先级选择；受控zone标签及priority映射是批准实验拓扑，不代表三台回环进程真的处于不同物理可用区。未证明生产故障域划分、网络分区或备用容量，应先核对真实拓扑再使用此策略。previous_priorities会在优先级耗尽后循环，故必须保留原有限重试次数，POST仍不可随意重放。不改外部网络或部署，不构建镜像。
answer:
```python
import copy
def configure(base):
    result=copy.deepcopy(base)
    routes=result["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["filter_chains"][0]["filters"][0]["typed_config"]["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"]
    selected=[route for route in routes if route.get("name")=="read"]
    if len(selected)!=1:raise ValueError("one approved read route required")
    selected[0]["route"]["retry_policy"]["retry_priority"]={
        "name":"envoy.retry_priorities.previous_priorities",
        "typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.retry.priority.previous_priorities.v3.PreviousPrioritiesConfig","update_frequency":1}}
    return result
```

原题知识说明：
避免重复选择同一host只排除了一个端点，不保证不同机架、可用区或共同依赖；多个端点也可能实际指向同一后端实例。应把每次attempt的host、locality和请求ID关联，区分单端点故障与共享故障域。验收一个host失败、整locality失效和下游公共依赖错误，比较重试成功率、放大倍数与总期限。重试谓词、优先级和负载策略的组合须按实际版本验证，不能凭参数名推断最终选择。交付无可用独立故障域时的拒绝或降级，不能在同一故障源上无限换IP重试。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import copy,json,pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path("checks").resolve()))
from envoy_native import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm
print("NATIVE_LINUX_READY",flush=True)
import task
with Upstream(status=503) as a1,Upstream(status=503) as a2,Upstream() as b1:
 peers={"A1":a1,"A2":a2,"B1":b1};zones={"A1":"zone-A","A2":"zone-A","B1":"zone-B"}
 base=bootstrap(a1.port);cluster=base["static_resources"]["clusters"][0]
 def endpoint(port):return {"endpoint":{"address":{"socket_address":{"address":"127.0.0.1","port_value":port}}}}
 cluster["load_assignment"]["endpoints"]=[
  {"priority":0,"locality":{"region":"training","zone":"zone-A"},"lb_endpoints":[endpoint(a1.port),endpoint(a2.port)]},
  {"priority":1,"locality":{"region":"training","zone":"zone-B"},"lb_endpoints":[endpoint(b1.port)]}]
 policy={"retry_on":"5xx","num_retries":1,"per_try_timeout":"0.2s",
  "host_selection_retry_max_attempts":5,
  "retry_host_predicate":[{"name":"envoy.retry_host_predicates.previous_hosts","typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.retry.host.previous_hosts.v3.PreviousHostsPredicate"}}]}
 hcm(base)["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"]=[
  {"name":"health","match":{"path":"/health"},"direct_response":{"status":200,"body":{"inline_string":"ready"}}},
  {"name":"read","match":{"path":"/read","headers":[{"name":":method","string_match":{"exact":"GET"}}]},"route":{"cluster":"service","timeout":"1s","retry_policy":policy}},
  {"name":"write","match":{"path":"/write","headers":[{"name":":method","string_match":{"exact":"POST"}}]},"route":{"cluster":"service","timeout":"1s"}},
  {"match":{"prefix":"/"},"direct_response":{"status":405}}]
 def probe(server,path,method="GET",body=None):
  before={name:len(peer.requests) for name,peer in peers.items()}
  status,raw,_=server.request(path,method=method,body=body)
  attempts=[name for name,peer in peers.items() for row in peer.requests[before[name]:]]
  return status,attempts
 with Envoy(base) as old:
  status,attempts=probe(old,"/read")
  assert status==503 and len(attempts)==2 and set(attempts)=={"A1","A2"} and not b1.requests
 print("NATIVE_PREVIOUS_HOSTS_RETRY_CHOOSES_DIFFERENT_HOST_BUT_SAME_PRIORITY_DOMAIN",flush=True)
 before=copy.deepcopy(base)
 print("STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: priority-aware bounded retry",flush=True)
 fixed=task.configure(base);assert base==before
 records=[]
 with Envoy(fixed) as server:
  for _ in range(4):
   status,attempts=probe(server,"/read")
   assert status==200 and len(attempts)==2 and sum(name=="B1" for name in attempts)==1 and sum(name in ("A1","A2") for name in attempts)==1,(status,attempts)
   records.append(dict(status=status,attempts=attempts,zones=[zones[name] for name in attempts]))
  status,attempts=probe(server,"/write",method="POST",body=b"approved-write")
  assert status==503 and len(attempts)==1 and attempts[0] in ("A1","A2"),"POST was replayed across domains"
  b1.status=503
  status,attempts=probe(server,"/read")
  assert status==503 and len(attempts)==2 and "B1" in attempts,"all-domain failure exceeded original two-attempt budget"
  records.append(dict(all_backends_503=True,status=status,attempts=attempts))
  a1.status=a2.status=200
  status,attempts=probe(server,"/read")
  assert status==200 and len(attempts)==1 and attempts[0] in ("A1","A2"),"healthy primary still incurred a retry"
  counts={name:len(peer.requests) for name,peer in peers.items()}
  assert server.request("/health")[:2]==(200,b"ready") and counts=={name:len(peer.requests) for name,peer in peers.items()}
  expected=copy.deepcopy(base);expected_policy=expected["static_resources"]["listeners"][0]["filter_chains"][0]["filters"][0]["typed_config"]["route_config"]["virtual_hosts"][0]["routes"][1]["route"]["retry_policy"]
  expected_policy["retry_priority"]={"name":"envoy.retry_priorities.previous_priorities","typed_config":{"@type":"type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.retry.priority.previous_priorities.v3.PreviousPrioritiesConfig","update_frequency":1}}
  assert fixed==expected,"only approved read retry-priority policy may change"
 print("NATIVE_RETRY_MOVES_TO_APPROVED_SECOND_PRIORITY_GET_TWO_ATTEMPTS_POST_ONCE_ALL_FAIL_BOUNDED "+json.dumps(records),flush=True)
print("NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED",flush=True)
